rules.content:
/*
Sugar / Encoded01 ransomware
*/

rule Sugar_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.sugar"
        description = "Detects Sugar / Encoded01 ransomware ransom note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "encoded01" ascii nocase
        $s2 = ".encoded01" ascii
        $s3 = "Sugar" ascii nocase
        $s4 = "sugarlocker" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
